THE_GAP_R66_PROPOSES_TO_FILL.claim: Every one of R43's twenty-four rates structures is either a SAME-COUNTRY CURVE spread or a CROSS-COUNTRY spread of the SAME tenor. Not one pairs a US Treasury future against a US short-rate future.
THE_GAP_R66_PROPOSES_TO_FILL.verification: RATES_STRUCTURES is a literal declared list at alpha_agent/r43/rv.py:81-98 and was read in full. The three STIR entries are ZQ/LEU, SR3/SO3, SR3/YIR - all cross-country. There is no (ZN, SR3), no (ZN, ZQ), no (ZF, SR3) and no (ZB, ZQ).
THE_GAP_R66_PROPOSES_TO_FILL.why_it_is_a_DIFFERENT_MECHANISM_not_a_re: A curve spread trades the SHAPE of one issuer's own curve; its risk factor is the slope of government yields. A Treasury-versus-short-rate spread trades the level of GOVERNMENT versus COLLATERALISED/INTERBANK funding at a matched point - the swap spread. Its drivers are balance-sheet cost, collateral scarcity, Treasury supply and the government-interbank basis. Swap spreads have historically gone NEGATIVE, which a curve spread cannot express at all. These are not the same factor and a duplicate-identity check on construction alone would not catch that - which is why the economic argument is written here for the director to rule on rather than asserted later.

the_axis_nobody_has_measured.observation: R43 measured these structures as TIMING signals and reported the unconditional premium only as a CONTROL. The estate therefore knows the premium is real and knows the timing is worthless, and has never asked what the STATIC hedged structure is worth per dollar of COMMITTED CAPITAL to a portfolio that already holds something else.
the_axis_nobody_has_measured.why_that_is_not_a_free_pass: The governance contract forbids adopting a strong-looking control or by-product, and the one unconditional structure the estate did surface (month-end ZN long, +1.47%/yr net, t 3.20 as a control) is HUMAN_GATED: adoptable only by a human-authorised fresh pre-registration on untouched data.
the_axis_nobody_has_measured.the_binding_problem: There is no untouched history left. The estate has consumed 1987-2026 across 8,445 hypotheses and R43 ran to 2026-08-24. Any measurement of these structures on that history is a RE-LOOK and must be labelled one. The only honest route to new evidence on a known premium is PROSPECTIVE registration and forward accrual.
the_axis_nobody_has_measured.director_must_rule_on: whether R66 may measure a static hedged structure at all, and if so whether the result may be reported as anything other than a declared re-look with no discovery status.
